person_note: The controlling narration is third person. Two lengthy Goodreads passages expose a nonparticipating narrator describing Pine and other characters externally, while the authorized interior excerpt independently sustains the same pattern across actions, memories, perceptions, and interior states. First-person forms elsewhere are direct dialogue, an explicitly tagged private thought, or a clipped passage with unresolved quotation boundaries; none demonstrates a sustained first-person section. The authorized excerpt covers only an interior section rather than the whole book, but its agreement with diagnostic quotes from other scenes and the absence of credible contrary structural evidence support high confidence.
